name: BigQuery
title: BigQuery generative AI functions
summary: Managed AI functions bring generation, filtering, classification and scoring into SQL over structured and unstructured data.
caveat: Function availability, supported models, regions and billing vary. Product documentation does not establish comparative engine performance.

name: Snowflake Cortex
title: Snowflake Cortex AI Functions / AISQL
summary: SQL-callable AI functions support classification, filtering, extraction, summarization and aggregation inside the Snowflake platform.
caveat: Check per-function documentation for model and regional support, pricing and release status. A product feature is not an independent benchmark.

name: Databricks
title: Databricks ai_query
summary: The ai_query function invokes a model-serving endpoint from SQL and parses the response for real-time or batch inference workflows.
caveat: Requires a supported runtime or SQL environment, region and endpoint permissions; not available on Databricks SQL Classic. No optimizer equivalence with research engines is implied.
